episodes.synopsis: In search of the 48 secret techniques, Mikoshiarashi travels to L.A. where his attire gets him in trouble immediately. Thankfully, he is saved by the master of distortion rock, Breaky, who might have a thing or two to teach the young sumo wrestler...
episodes.title: L.A. Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Hitchhiking up north in Canada, Arashi-kun passes out in a sudden blizzard, but is saved by the girlfriend of Canadian Ice Hockey Star Justin.
episodes.title: Montreal Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Tricked by a taxi cab driver, Arashi-kun is in dire need of money, stranded in the middle of New York City. With no where else to turn, he enters a funky dance contest, only to find that the local dance legend, Bootsy, may hold the secret to one of the 48 techniques...
episodes.title: New York Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi is scouted by the manager for the New York Nyankees for his amazing arm, and the home run king of the Cleveland Iideyansu, Rodry, is seriously mad at having his spotlight taken away.
episodes.title: Cleveland Tournament

episodes.synopsis: While visiting the White House, Arashi is mistakenly arrested for being the ringleader of a terrorist organization. But thanks to his keen eye, he helps Edgar, the nation's top FBI watchdog, apprehend the real mastermind.
episodes.title: D.C. Tournament

episodes.synopsis: After being introduced to the wonders of tequila at a Mexican bar, Arashi is taken in by a mysterious masked wrestler who recruits Arashi as his new partner.
episodes.title: Mexico Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Still feeling quite happy after his Mexican wrestling adventure, Arashi talks back to a Cuban military patrol and is thrown into jail along with other political prisoners. Never giving up hope, they wait for the day their hero, Guevaran, will lead an attack to rescue them...
episodes.title: Cuba Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Impressed by the sites and tastes of the island, Arashi is faced with a choice between two restaurants. But it seems the entire country is on the verge of a civil war between two political parties.
episodes.title: Jamaica Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Hearing news of a mysterious hermit that lives deep in the Amazon Jungle, Arashi goes to see him in search of another one of the 48 techniques.
episodes.title: Amazon Tournament

episodes.synopsis: In a rush to get to the airport, Arashi gets on the wrong bus. When that bus breaks down near a coffee plantation, Arashi heads to a famous local coffee shop.
episodes.title: Columbia Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi is looking forward to getting on board a cruise ship, but all the tickets are sold out. With no where else to turn, he offers to help out a young man who says he knows the captain of the ship, but...
episodes.title: Argentina Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Enjoying his Atlantic cruise, Arashi hears rumors of a vicious pirate named Hawk who has been attacking ships. There's no way he'd actually attack this ship though...
episodes.title: Caribbean Sea Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Having successfully beaten off the pirates, Arashi is back on his way to Europe. But Captain Hawk wants revenge! Arashi and the rest of the ship is saved at the last moment by a gallant explorer...
episodes.title: Atlantic Ocean Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arriving finally in Europe, Arashi is transfixed by all the beautiful women. Catching one, on the other hand, proves to be quite a challenge...
episodes.title: Pamplona Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Back in Japan, Arashi's rival Tetsunishiki is racking up wins in the sumo world. A mysterious architect helps Arashi regain his motivation to keep going on his quest to become the greatest sumo wrestler in the world.
episodes.title: Barcelona Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi becomes quick pals with Emperor Napoleonne, and offers to help him invade Italy by crossing the Alps. Thanks to their indomitable spirit, they overcome the shear ludicrousness of the concept and somehow emerge victorious.
episodes.title: Paris Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi confronts a man secretly taking pictures of him around Paris, and it turns out he's a budding photographer who's just really shy. Arashi offers to be his practice subject, and gets scouted to be the next top model.
episodes.title: Paris Collection Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi sits down for a nice full course French meal, but seems to not understand how to properly savor the experience. At a local winery, he learns the secret to using all 5 of his sense...
episodes.title: Bourgogne Tournament

episodes.synopsis: After running into a funny, boy-like character in a London pub, Arashi is taken to "pure heart land," an island where kids never grow up. But just as he arrives, the evil Captain Hoo-kun appears...
episodes.title: London Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Outside a stately mansion, Arashi is caught up in a murder investigation.
episodes.title: Scotland Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Entering Germany for the first time, Arashi feels like having a beer, but gets in a car accident while trying to save a puppy. Arashi is fine, but the car is another story...
episodes.title: Stuttgart Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi meets up with a small girl and helps her carry some heavy bags back to her cabin in the Alps. Inside the cabin, however, is a familiar face...
episodes.title: Alps Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi's in Switzerland, the land of banks, but plum out of cash. Heading to a bank to withdraw some money, Arashi is caught up in an attempted robbery, and meets Meister, a master Swiss watchmaker. Meister helps Arashi with a complete tune-up: Of both his watch, and his body.
episodes.title: Switzerland Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi is invited to a feast at the Austrian court in honor of his victory at the Champion's Tournament, and he runs into the world's greatest composer, Mozun. The ever polite Arashi is asked to help teach Mozun some manners, but ends up becoming the inspiration for his latest symphony instead.
episodes.title: Austria Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi is going for a walk in Sweden when suddenly a nearby house explodes! Sir Nobelson, a scientist inventor, has finally completed his greatest invention, dynamite, to help his friend finish building a tunnel. But there are people who would use such power for evil in this world...
episodes.title: Sweden Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi is in Finland on Christmas Eve, when he happens upon Santa's workshop! Arashi is eager to help deliver presents but Santa seems somewhat different than how he had imagined him to be...
episodes.title: Finland Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi goes for a swim in a heated pool to warm up from the cold of the Moscow's winter, when he encounters a group of synchronized swimmers. The leader of the group, Elschenko, tries to recruit Arashi into the group, but he thinks the sport is too feminine. Arashi soon learns that displays of grace require incredible strength out of sight.
episodes.title: Russia Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi is lost in a dark forest somewhere in Romania, when he comes across a kind young woman who offers to let him rest in her house. It seems that she's just happy to finally have a visitor she can talk to...
episodes.title: Romania Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi pays a visit to the Parthenon and stumbles upon a meeting of the gods. Sent as a representative of humanity to Hades, Arashi must convince Hadus, the lord of the underworld, that humanity is worth saving. This might be one bout Arashi can't win through force...
episodes.title: Greece Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi ventures into Istanbul, where he heads to a local sauna for a bath. But he runs into the divine oily god of Turkish Sumo, Ozman. Which Sumo with rein supreme?! Watch out, Arashi...
episodes.title: Turkey Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi is wandering in the desert, desperately searching for some water, when he comes across some giant pyramids being built. He helps with the construction in exchange for some water, and meets King Phara-oh. But when Cleonpatran shows up, Phara-oh runs off for some reason...
episodes.title: Egypt Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi marvels at the natural beauty of the savanna, that is, until a lion almost eats him! Saved by the head of the local village, Elmoran, Arashi helps hunt Big Daddy, a giant lion that's been attacking people.
episodes.title: Kenya Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi arrives in Thailand, and gets picked up by a tour guide in a Tuk-Tuk taxi. After seeing a giant Buddha and riding an elephant, he's taken to see some Thai boxing.
episodes.title: Thailand Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi finds himself in Mongolia, a rival country in the sport of sumo wrestling, but something seems amiss in the village. It seems a single man has been going around challenging all the villages to a sumo bout with the entire village on the line! Arashi heads out to stop this person, and to learn from a powerful foe.
episodes.title: Mongolia Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi is in China, and is mistaken for Zhuge Liang by Liu Long and his followers Fei Chang and Yu Guan. Arashi volunteers to go to ask QiÃ„?n Sun to form an alliance with Liu Long in order to defeat the evil Chancellor Cao CÃ„?ng CÃ„?ng.
episodes.title: China Tournament

episodes.synopsis: Arashi is drawn to the glittering lights of Macao's casinos, and runs into an old friend, Badri! The two of them get on a huge winning streak, and attract the attention of the owner of the casino, the genius gambler Hoho, who invites Arashi for a personal duel...
episodes.title: Macao Tournament
